words.note: 最常用來修飾可數名詞複數，表示數量多。
words.example: Many students joined the after-school program.
words.exampleZh: 很多學生參加了課後活動。

exercises.original: A lot of students joined the after-school program.
exercises.zh: 很多學生參加了課後活動。
exercises.upgrade: many · 很多的；許多的

options.explanation: much = much 主要修飾不可數名詞；students 是可數名詞複數。
many = many 修飾可數名詞複數，many students 最自然。
little = little 表示少，而且通常修飾不可數名詞。
enough = enough 只表示足夠，不一定表示很多。
very = very 通常修飾形容詞或副詞，不能直接說 very students。
amount = amount 是名詞，而且通常和不可數名詞搭配。

exercises.original: A lot of people use the park at weekends.
exercises.zh: 很多人在週末使用這個公園。
exercises.upgrade: many · 很多的；許多的

options.explanation: many = many 修飾可數名詞複數，many people 很自然。
much = much 通常修飾不可數名詞，不能說 much people。
little = little 表示少，而且修飾不可數名詞。
amount = amount 是名詞，不能直接修飾 people。
very = very 不能直接表示名詞數量。
few = few 表示很少，意思相反。

words.note: 較正式，表示數量相當多，常用於書面語。
words.example: The museum received numerous complaints about the new ticketing system.
words.exampleZh: 博物館收到很多關於新售票系統的投訴。

exercises.original: The museum received a lot of complaints about the new ticketing system.
exercises.zh: 博物館收到很多關於新售票系統的投訴。
exercises.upgrade: numerous · 眾多的；很多的

options.explanation: numerous = numerous 較正式，適合修飾 complaints 這類可數名詞複數。
enough = enough 只表示足夠，不一定表示眾多。
little = little 表示少，而且通常修飾不可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接修飾 complaints 表示數量。
amount = amount 是名詞，而且通常配不可數名詞。
much = much 不修飾 complaints 這種可數名詞複數。

exercises.original: The researcher found a lot of errors in the old records.
exercises.zh: 研究人員在舊紀錄中發現很多錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: numerous · 眾多的；很多的

options.explanation: few = few 表示很少，意思相反。
numerous = numerous 表示數量相當多，numerous errors 是自然的書面搭配。
enough = enough 只表示足夠，不表示很多。
very = very 不能直接修飾可數名詞。
little = little 修飾不可數名詞，而且表示少。
amount = amount 是名詞，不能直接修飾 errors。

words.note: 主要修飾不可數名詞，尤其常見於否定句、疑問句或較正式語境。
words.example: The project required much time and careful planning.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目需要大量時間和仔細規劃。

exercises.original: The project required a lot of time and careful planning.
exercises.zh: 這個項目需要大量時間和仔細規劃。
exercises.upgrade: much · 很多的；大量的

options.explanation: many = many 修飾可數名詞複數；time 在這裡是不可數名詞。
much = much 修飾不可數名詞，在較正式書面語中很自然。
several = several 修飾可數名詞複數，不能說 several time。
few = few 修飾可數名詞，而且表示少。
number = number 通常和可數名詞使用。
very = very 不能直接表示 time 的數量。

exercises.original: There was not a lot of information available at the time.
exercises.zh: 當時沒有很多資料可供使用。
exercises.upgrade: much · 很多的；大量的

options.explanation: many = information 是不可數名詞，不能說 many information。
several = several 需要可數名詞複數。
much = 否定句中 not much information 非常自然。
number = number 通常配可數名詞。
few = few 修飾可數名詞複數。
very = very 不能直接表示資料數量。

words.note: 修飾不可數名詞，常見於較正式或強調數量很多的語境。
words.example: The investigation attracted a great deal of public attention.
words.exampleZh: 這項調查引起了大量公眾關注。

exercises.original: The investigation attracted a lot of public attention.
exercises.zh: 這項調查引起了大量公眾關注。
exercises.upgrade: a great deal of · 大量的；很多的

options.explanation: many = attention 是不可數名詞，不能用 many。
a great deal of = a great deal of 修飾不可數名詞，a great deal of attention 很自然。
few = few 修飾可數名詞，而且表示少。
several = several 修飾可數名詞複數。
number of = number of 應配可數名詞複數。
very = very 不能直接修飾 attention 表示數量。

exercises.original: She spent a lot of time preparing for the interview.
exercises.zh: 她花了大量時間準備面試。
exercises.upgrade: a great deal of · 大量的；很多的

options.explanation: a great deal of = time 是不可數名詞，a great deal of time 能自然表示大量時間。
many = many 不能說 many time 表示大量時間。
several = several 需要可數名詞複數。
few = few 表示少，而且修飾可數名詞。
number of = number of 配可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接修飾 time 表示數量。

words.note: 表示數量不但多，而且足夠使用。
words.example: There is plenty of food for everyone at the party.
words.exampleZh: 派對上有充足的食物供所有人享用。

exercises.original: There is a lot of food for everyone at the party, so nobody needs to worry.
exercises.zh: 派對上有充足的食物供所有人享用，所以不用擔心不夠。
exercises.upgrade: plenty of · 很多的；充足的

options.explanation: few = few 表示少，而且 food 在這裡是不可數名詞。
plenty of = plenty of 不只表示多，還帶有足夠而有餘的意思。
little = little food 表示食物很少，意思相反。
very = very 不能直接修飾 food 表示數量。
number of = number of 配可數名詞。
several = several 配可數名詞複數。

exercises.original: We have a lot of chairs for the guests, with several extra ones left over.
exercises.zh: 我們有充足的椅子給客人使用，而且還多出幾張。
exercises.upgrade: plenty of · 很多的；充足的

options.explanation: plenty of = 有幾張多出來，說明數量足夠而有餘，plenty of 最貼切。
little = little 表示少，而且修飾不可數名詞。
much = chairs 是可數名詞複數，不能用 much。
very = very 不能直接修飾 chairs。
amount of = amount of 通常修飾不可數名詞。
few = few chairs 表示椅子很少，意思相反。

words.note: 修飾可數名詞複數，較中性和正式。
words.example: A large number of applicants attended the recruitment event.
words.exampleZh: 大量申請者參加了招聘活動。

exercises.original: A lot of applicants attended the recruitment event.
exercises.zh: 大量申請者參加了招聘活動。
exercises.upgrade: a large number of · 大量的；很多的

options.explanation: a large number of = applicants 是可數名詞複數，a large number of 很自然而且較正式。
much = much 不修飾可數名詞複數。
little = little 修飾不可數名詞，而且表示少。
amount of = amount of 通常配不可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接修飾 applicants。
several = several 只表示幾個，不一定是大量。

exercises.original: A lot of visitors came to the exhibition during its opening week.
exercises.zh: 展覽開幕首週有大量訪客前來。
exercises.upgrade: a large number of · 大量的；很多的

options.explanation: much = much 不修飾 visitors。
a large number of = a large number of 用於可數名詞複數，適合較正式描述大量訪客。
little = little 用於不可數名詞，而且表示少。
very = very 不能直接表示訪客數量。
amount of = amount of 通常修飾不可數名詞。
few = few 表示很少，意思相反。

words.note: 修飾可數名詞複數，表示數量大得值得注意。
words.example: A considerable number of residents opposed the proposal.
words.exampleZh: 相當多居民反對這項建議。

exercises.original: A lot of residents opposed the proposal, enough to attract the council's attention.
exercises.zh: 相當多居民反對這項建議，數量多得引起市議會注意。
exercises.upgrade: a considerable number of · 相當多的

options.explanation: a considerable number of = 表示數量大得值得注意，和引起市議會注意的語境吻合。
little = little 不修飾 residents，而且表示少。
much = much 不修飾可數名詞複數。
very = very 不能直接修飾 residents 表示數量。
amount of = amount of 通常配不可數名詞。
few = few 表示很少，意思相反。

exercises.original: A lot of employees chose to work from home after the policy changed.
exercises.zh: 政策改變後，相當多員工選擇在家工作。
exercises.upgrade: a considerable number of · 相當多的

options.explanation: several = several 表示幾個，數量比 considerable number 弱得多。
a considerable number of = 表示值得注意的較大數量，適合描述很多員工作出同一選擇。
very = very 不能直接修飾 employees。
little = little 表示少，而且配不可數名詞。
amount of = amount of 不適合 employees。
much = much 不修飾可數名詞複數。

words.note: 修飾不可數名詞，表示份量或數量相當大。
words.example: The repair work will require a substantial amount of money.
words.exampleZh: 維修工程將需要大量金錢。

exercises.original: The repair work will require a lot of money.
exercises.zh: 維修工程將需要大量金錢。
exercises.upgrade: a substantial amount of · 大量的；相當多的

options.explanation: many = money 是不可數名詞，不能用 many。
a substantial amount of = a substantial amount of money 表示相當大的份量，正式自然。
few = few 修飾可數名詞，而且表示少。
number of = number of 配可數名詞。
several = several 不能修飾 money。
very = very 不能直接修飾 money 表示數量。

exercises.original: The factory uses a lot of electricity every day.
exercises.zh: 工廠每天使用大量電力。
exercises.upgrade: a substantial amount of · 大量的；相當多的

options.explanation: several = electricity 是不可數名詞，不能用 several。
many = many 修飾可數名詞複數。
a substantial amount of = a substantial amount of 能自然表達大量電力。
few = few 修飾可數名詞，而且表示少。
number of = number of 不配 electricity。
very = very 不能直接表示電力的數量。

words.note: 表示某物很多、很充裕，常帶有「資源豐富」的感覺。
words.example: The region has an abundance of natural resources.
words.exampleZh: 該地區擁有豐富的天然資源。

exercises.original: The region has a lot of natural resources.
exercises.zh: 該地區擁有豐富的天然資源。
exercises.upgrade: an abundance of · 大量的；豐富的

options.explanation: few = few 表示很少，意思相反。
an abundance of = an abundance of 表示資源很多而充裕，搭配自然。
little = little 表示少，而且通常修飾不可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接表示 resources 的數量。
enough = enough 只表示足夠，不一定豐富。
much = resources 是可數名詞複數，不能用 much。

exercises.original: The garden contains a lot of colourful flowers in spring.
exercises.zh: 花園在春天有大量色彩繽紛的花朵。
exercises.upgrade: an abundance of · 大量的；豐富的

options.explanation: an abundance of = 強調花朵很多、很豐盛，和花園語境很配合。
little = little 不修飾 flowers，而且表示少。
much = much 不修飾可數名詞複數。
very = very 不能直接修飾 flowers 表示數量。
enough = enough 只是足夠，沒有「豐富」的意思。
few = few 表示很少，意思相反。

words.note: 表示數量不只足夠，而且有相當餘裕。
words.example: The hall provides ample space for large events.
words.exampleZh: 這個禮堂為大型活動提供充足空間。

exercises.original: The hall has a lot of space for large events, with room left over.
exercises.zh: 這個禮堂有充足空間舉辦大型活動，而且仍有餘位。
exercises.upgrade: ample · 充足的；足夠而有餘的

options.explanation: little = little space 表示空間很少，意思相反。
ample = ample 表示充足而有餘，和 room left over 呼應。
few = few 修飾可數名詞複數。
several = several 不能修飾不可數名詞 space。
number = number 通常配可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接修飾 space 表示數量。

exercises.original: We have a lot of time to finish the task, so there is no need to rush.
exercises.zh: 我們有充足時間完成工作，所以不用趕急。
exercises.upgrade: ample · 充足的；足夠而有餘的

options.explanation: ample = 沒有趕急的需要，說明時間不只是夠，而是相當充裕。
few = few 不修飾不可數名詞 time。
several = several 不能直接表示大量時間。
number of = number of 配可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接表示 time 的數量。
little = little time 表示時間很少，意思相反。

words.note: 表示數量極多，多得難以計算。
words.example: The internet gives students access to countless learning resources.
words.exampleZh: 互聯網讓學生接觸到數不盡的學習資源。

exercises.original: The internet gives students access to a lot of learning resources from around the world.
exercises.zh: 互聯網讓學生接觸到數不盡的世界各地學習資源。
exercises.upgrade: countless · 數不盡的；無數的

options.explanation: little = little 表示少，而且不修飾 resources。
countless = countless 表示多得難以計算，適合形容互聯網上的大量資源。
enough = enough 表示足夠，不表示數量極多。
much = resources 是可數名詞複數，不能用 much。
amount of = amount of 通常配不可數名詞。
few = few 表示很少，意思相反。

exercises.original: Over the years, she received a lot of messages from readers around the world.
exercises.zh: 多年來，她收到世界各地讀者數不盡的訊息。
exercises.upgrade: countless · 數不盡的；無數的

options.explanation: countless = 多年累積、來自世界各地，countless messages 能突出數量極多。
little = little 不能修飾 messages，而且表示少。
very = very 不能直接修飾 messages 表示數量。
amount of = amount of 通常不修飾可數名詞複數。
much = much 不修飾 messages。
enough = enough 只表示足夠。

words.meaning: 無數的；大量各式各樣的
words.note: 較正式，表示數量極多，常帶有種類繁多的感覺。
words.example: The city offers a myriad of dining options.
words.exampleZh: 這個城市提供無數不同的餐飲選擇。

exercises.original: The city offers a lot of dining options from many different cuisines.
exercises.zh: 這個城市提供無數來自不同菜系的餐飲選擇。
exercises.upgrade: myriad · 無數的；大量各式各樣的

options.explanation: few = few 表示少，意思相反。
myriad = myriad 表示數量極多，亦常帶有種類繁多的感覺。
little = little 不修飾 options。
very = very 不能直接表示 options 的數量。
much = much 不修飾可數名詞複數。
amount = amount 是名詞，而且一般和不可數名詞搭配。

exercises.original: Modern smartphones can be used for a lot of different purposes.
exercises.zh: 現代智能手機可以作無數不同用途。
exercises.upgrade: myriad · 無數的；大量各式各樣的

options.explanation: myriad = a myriad of different purposes 強調用途非常多而且種類繁多。
enough = enough 表示足夠，不表示種類繁多。
little = little 不修飾 purposes。
much = much 不修飾可數名詞複數。
amount of = amount of 通常配不可數名詞。
few = few 表示很少。

words.note: 強調範圍廣或內容多，常修飾 research、experience、damage、coverage 等。
words.example: The report is based on extensive research.
words.exampleZh: 這份報告以大量而廣泛的研究為基礎。

exercises.original: The report is based on a lot of research carried out in several countries.
exercises.zh: 這份報告以在多個國家進行的大量而廣泛研究為基礎。
exercises.upgrade: extensive · 大量的；廣泛的

options.explanation: extensive = extensive research 表示研究範圍廣、內容多，多個國家的資料正好支持這個意思。
few = few 不能修飾不可數名詞 research。
several = research 在這裡是不可數名詞，不能直接用 several。
very = very 不能直接修飾 research 表示數量。
number of = number of 配可數名詞。
many = many 不修飾不可數名詞 research。

exercises.original: The storm caused a lot of damage across the entire coastal region.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨在整個沿海地區造成廣泛而大量的破壞。
exercises.upgrade: extensive · 大量的；廣泛的

options.explanation: little = little damage 表示破壞很少，意思相反。
extensive = 整個沿海地區都受影響，重點是破壞範圍廣，所以 extensive damage 最準確。
several = damage 在這裡是不可數名詞。
many = 不能說 many damage。
number of = number of 不適合不可數名詞 damage。
enough = enough 表示足夠，不適合描述破壞程度。

words.note: 表示某物以很大的份量出現，較正式，常修飾 notes、details、evidence、information 等。
words.example: She took copious notes during the lecture.
words.exampleZh: 她在講座期間記下了大量筆記。

exercises.original: She took a lot of notes during the three-hour lecture.
exercises.zh: 她在三小時的講座期間記下了大量筆記。
exercises.upgrade: copious · 大量的；豐富的

options.explanation: little = little 不修飾 notes，而且表示少。
copious = copious notes 是常見搭配，表示大量而豐富的筆記。
much = notes 是可數名詞複數，不能用 much。
very = very 不能直接修飾 notes 表示數量。
enough = enough 只表示足夠，沒有「大量」的強度。
amount of = amount of 通常配不可數名詞。

exercises.original: The witness provided a lot of detailed information about what happened.
exercises.zh: 目擊者提供了大量詳細資料，說明事情的經過。
exercises.upgrade: copious · 大量的；豐富的

options.explanation: copious = copious detailed information 表示大量而詳盡的資料，適合正式語境。
few = few 不修飾不可數名詞 information。
several = information 是不可數名詞，不能直接用 several。
number of = number of 配可數名詞。
very = very 不能直接表示 information 的數量。
little = little information 表示資料很少，意思相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 非常不等於很多 very 通常修飾形容詞或副詞，不直接表示名詞的數量很多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The class was very interesting. Many students attended the class.

falseSynonyms.zh: 足夠不等於很多 enough 只表示達到需要的數量，不一定很多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We have enough chairs for everyone. We have many chairs in the hall.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幾個不等於很多 several 通常表示多於兩三個，但沒有 many 或 numerous 那麼多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Several students asked questions. Many students stayed after class.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可數與不可數不同 many 修飾可數名詞複數；much 主要修飾不可數名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Many people attended. Much information was collected.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞類型不同 a number of 修飾可數名詞複數；an amount of 修飾不可數名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A large number of cars were sold. A large amount of fuel was used.

falseSynonyms.zh: 少了 of 結構不完整 lots of 可以表示很多，但 lots 不能在這種結構中直接放在名詞前。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Lots of people came to the event. We cannot normally say “lots people”.

falseSynonyms.zh: 少不等於多 few 和 little 表示數量少，意思和 a lot of 相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Few students were absent. Many students were present.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性不同 abundant 是形容詞；abundance 是名詞。句子結構不同，不能隨意互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The area has abundant wildlife. The area has an abundance of wildlife.
